scope: Different-author source-only hammer of M2012 under CPython 3.6 and 3.12. All executable mutation was confined to TemporaryDirectory namespaces. No production process capture, archive, canonical shard or payload namespace, merge, reducer, GPU, or EDA was opened or executed.

p1.finding: inspect_import_work_topology returns complete solely when the three allowed pathnames exist. A normal mid-copy boundary with all three names but a truncated final seal is therefore sent to complete-orphan verification, rejected, preserved at the fixed import-work name, and rejected again forever. The independent hammer reproduced two consecutive failures with no target publication.
p1.impact: M2010's interrupted-copy recovery is still incomplete at a real copytree boundary; the only manual resume path can remain permanently stranded.
p1.required_repair: An additive M2015 successor must authenticate the seal, not filenames alone. A three-name tree with an invalid or incomplete seal must be moved without overwrite into evidence quarantine and restarted from a reverified staged source. A valid sealed tree that mismatches the plan must remain preserved and rejected. Add permanent before-copy, subset-mid-copy, all-names-truncated, after-seal, before-publish, and malicious-sealed regressions.

p1.finding: capture_process_identity reads FUTURE_REVIEW/review.json with strict_json but never verifies the sealed review tree and never requires score >=95 or severity_counts == {p0:0,p1:0,p2:0}. An unsealed synthetic review with score 0 and nine findings at each severity, but copied status/identity/authorization fields, successfully published a sealed PRESTOP receipt in TemporaryDirectory.
p1.impact: A forged or incomplete reviewer artifact can consume the no-replace process-receipt namespace before an admitted different-author review, preventing legitimate capture and weakening the stop/release chain.
p1.required_repair: Before the first PID read or .work creation, verify FUTURE_REVIEW as a sealed tree and require exact review status, identity, score >=95, zero P0/P1/P2, and exact authorization. Permanently reject unsealed, score-below-threshold, nonzero-severity, malformed-manifest, and outer-seal-drift reviews.

single_next_action: Create one additively numbered M2015 source successor that distinguishes invalid-seal all-name partial copies from valid sealed plan mismatches and authenticates the sealed zero-finding M2013 review before process capture; then obtain a new different-author source hammer before any process capture or release authoring.
